description: Filter the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code registry by country, operating MIC, status and/or a name fragment. Returns aggregate counts first (total matched, by_status, by_country) and a page of rows after. Use operating_mic to list every segment market under one venue operator (e.g. every segment under "XNYS").

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the venue, e.g. "US", "GB", "JP".

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive fragment of the market name, legal entity name or acronym, e.g. "nasdaq".

operating_mic.description: List every market (segment or operating) under this operating MIC, e.g. "XNYS" to list NYSE's own segments.

name: search_mics
title: Search Mics
